units: <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:9">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>שבעה … תורה ת׳ וכ׳</he> seven things were created before the world was made, they are: the Law, repentance &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 119a:5">Ib. 119ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:8">Ez. I, 8</cite>) <he>זה ידו … כדי לקבל בעלי ת׳</he> that is the hand of the Lord which is spread under the wings of the Ḥayoth (v. <cite ref="H00672"><he>חַיָּה</he> I</cite>) to receive the repentant sinners.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:22">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>מקום שבעלי ת׳ עומדין וכ׳</he> where the repentant sinners stand, the perfectly righteous are not permitted to stand, for it is said (<cite ref="Isaiah 57:19">Is. LVII, 19</cite>) &c.

<cite ref="Yevamot 21a:8">Yeb. 21ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>הני אפשר בת׳ הני לא אפשר בת׳</he> these sins (of incest) may be remedied by repentance, but those (of giving false measures) cannot be remedied by repentance (because you can make no restoration).

Pesik. R. s. 28 (ref. to Ps. CXXXVII, 2) בא וראה עפרה … לת׳ וכ׳ come and see (the power of the love of) the dust of the land of Israel for repentance: as long as they were in the land of Israel, Jeremiah said to them, do penance, &c.; a. fr.— reply, answer.
<cite ref="Shabbat 88b:8">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>החזיר להן ת׳</he> give them an answer (refute their argument).

<cite ref="Pesachim 94a:13">Pes. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>מה ת׳ השיבתו בת קול וכ׳</he> what was the reply the divine voice gave to that wicked man (Nebuchadnezzar), when he said (<cite ref="Isaiah 14:13">Is. XIV, 13</cite>) , I will rise &c.?; <cite ref="Chagigah 13a:2">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91a:13">Snh. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>החזירו לו ת׳</he> make your argument against him; <he>לא מצאו ת׳</he> they could find nothing to reply. Ib. 105ᵃ, v. <cite ref="N01110"><he>נִצֵּחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44b:7">Ab. Zar. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ גנובה</he>, v. <cite ref="C01078"><he>גָּנַב</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תְּשׁוּבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 12b:8">Yoma 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שתי ת׳ בדבר חדא וכ׳</he> there are two arguments against it, first that &c.; <cite ref="Ketubot 87b:13">Keth. 87ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:2">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>בעל ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01055"><he>בַּעַל</he></cite>.
